mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in positive FEDFUNDS change periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in 3 months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls by more than 0.3 percentage points in 3 months, it indicates a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 3 months
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), strong demand for consumer goods and services increases corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200, 60-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, 5-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening economy with rising output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in positive INDPRO change periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) both rise by more than 0.5% in 3 months, it indicates a robust economy with strong supply and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months AND HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both rise > 0.5% in 3 months, 60-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 208.5), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 208.5, 20-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
